front.title: Catalog Binding for Forward Error Correction in Media over QUIC

abstract.t: This document binds the Forward Error Correction (FEC) configuration data model of the MoQ FEC core mechanism to the catalog of the MOQT Streaming Format (MSF) and to its Common Media Application Format (CMAF) profile. It defines the track-level "fec" array of FEC instance objects, the fields with which a repair track or a symbol track describes its own role, the packaging values "fec-repair" and "fec-source", the validation rules that are specific to the catalog encoding, and the handling of unknown keys, so that a receiver that obtains a track's catalog entry can configure its decoder without in- session signaling.
